Pricing

Ten trips free. Then $19.99, once.

Every feature is included from your first trip. The purchase does one thing: it lets you keep adding trips past ten.

Plans

Free

10 trips

Every feature is included: catches, photos, maps, recaps, PDF books, and backups. Past trips you add count toward the ten.

Lifetime

$19.99 once

Keep adding trips with no subscription. One purchase through the App Store.

Monthly

$1.99 a month

The same unlimited trips, paid monthly instead. Cancel any time in your App Store subscriptions.

  • Past trips you add count toward the ten.
  • After ten trips, existing trips, editing, sharing, PDF exports, and backups stay available.
  • Buying lifetime does not cancel a monthly subscription. Cancel it in your App Store subscriptions.
  • Purchases are handled by Apple. Prices are in US dollars and may vary by country.

Questions

What counts as a trip?

Any trip in your journal, whether you logged it on the day or added it later as a past trip. Trips in the built-in sample journal do not count.

What happens after ten trips?

Nothing you have saved is locked. Your existing trips stay open, and editing, sharing, recaps, PDF exports, and backups all keep working. You need to unlock only to add an eleventh trip.

What does the lifetime purchase include?

Unlimited trips, with no subscription. It is a one-time purchase of $19.99 through the App Store.

What if I cancel the monthly option?

Your saved trips stay accessible. To add new trips beyond ten, you would need an active unlock again.

Can I use it on more than one device?

Purchases can be restored on your other devices through the App Store, and your journal syncs through your own private iCloud. The Mac app is available now. iPhone and iPad are coming soon.

Is there an account, or ads?

No. There is no account to create and there are no ads on any plan.
